editorial_notes: Logic and kalām are constituent sections of one 1387 treatise, not separate authored works; their analytical nodes are labelled accordingly.
Distinguish an original commentary, a gloss, a critique, and a report of abridgement. The section relationships are structural, not doctrinal influence.
The 1560 completion date for Yazdī is supported; competing death dates 981 and 1015 AH remain visible.
Lāhījī's Persian direct commentary and gloss on Yazdī are treated as distinct according to references, subject to future manuscript collation.
Al-Mīrī's exact identity is not resolved; the Gelenbevī branch is marked qualified rather than equated with Mīr Zāhid.
Sanandajī's Taqrīb and its printed appendices are not conflated; 335-page 1901 volume is the checked physical extent.
Manuscript copy and later printing dates remain bounds, never silently converted into composition dates.

Correction: Do not attribute Tuḥfat-i Shāhjahānī to Ilāhī Bakhsh al-Fayḍābādī without independent evidence; Shāh Mīrī's separate Sharḥ is instead documented. Its 957 AH manuscript is only a copy-date upper bound.
